Does each capability work with real models? Scripted scenarios with deterministic checks and judge-scored rubric items, run once per model.

Part of the benchmark suite (#65, `docs/ROADMAP-STABILIZATION.md`). Harness: `backend/benchmarks/`. Every run is listed, including failed and budget-stopped ones. Rubric items are scored by a judge model, which is not told the model or configuration; a judge score is one model's reading of a transcript, not ground truth.

Criteria: `docs/benchmarks/criteria-DRAFT.md` is a **draft, not adopted**; Kohl decides the criteria. A run made against draft criteria is marked DRAFT below, and its pass/fail lines are provisional.
